picks.name: DJ Python
picks.source_note: Already in your library. Lead single from a forthcoming EP.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Forgetful Angel" (feat. Tony Bontana) (September 23, 2026, XL Recordings) is the lead single from his upcoming EP "to accomplish many things" (out Oct 23) -- a track meditating on distance, memory and letting go.
picks.why_listen: A moody, vocal-led preview of new material from a dependable favorite -- useful for a slower, more reflective stretch of a set.

picks.name: Ahadadream
picks.source_note: New artist discovery. UK bass/grime/UK funky territory connected to your Karen Nyame KG and Eliza Rose-adjacent picks.
picks.bio: "P ★ K I" (September 18, 2026, Island/Dialled In Records) is his debut album -- eleven tracks blending UK bass, grime, UK funky and global club music, with guests including Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan, Eliza Rose, Capo Lee and Skrillex.
picks.why_listen: A bold, genre-spanning debut rooted in club culture with heavyweight guest turns -- versatile, percussive material across a set.
